highlight.note: Read from the organisation as it is now; while it loads, a skeleton says “Drawing the organisation”.
The key: an arrow for what someone works on, the elbow a report hangs from, the dot of someone at work now — and when it was read.
One card per team: those who work across the organisation first, then each division, each with how many people it has.
Each person: their name (it opens their page), their role, “Working” while at work, and what they work on. Their reports sit indented under them.
Nothing is cut short: a long name wraps. The cards fill the width — as many across as fit, one under another on a phone.
